scalar_int8_window: The name int8 is a profile label. FMA/mul use INT8-derived BF16 A/B, while FMA C remains random FP32. For add2, A is unused and both B/C remain random FP32; its int8-named window is not an INT8-derived arithmetic workload.
matrix_int8_window: N64 inputs are BF16-exact x in signedINT8/128 and weights in [-127,127], with exact FP32 mathematical sums independently verified for48 frames.
scope: Do not treat the add2 profile energy difference as an integer-versus-floating precision comparison. Primary user comparison uses normal N64 full-frame power/energy.
